title: The Findings Overview and Remediation dashboards in the Identities menu: widgets, filters, views and PDF export

prose.label: Open questions.
prose.text: No time range, refresh interval or retention is stated for these dashboards {{gap:dashboard-time-range}}. What the easy, moderate and difficult ratings mean is open {{gap:ease-criteria}}.

checks.do: Which dashboard (Findings Overview or Remediation) holds the widget being read before quoting a count.

overview-scope.statement: The Findings Overview dashboard analyzes identity findings by severity, finding type, tenant, identity, asset and user type, and shows their exploitability and remediation ease.

quotes: You can analyze findings by severity, finding type, tenant, identity, asset, and user type, and view their exploitability and remediation ease.

overview-location.statement: The Findings Overview dashboard is opened by clicking Identities in the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal and then Overview in the left-side navigation.

quotes: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Identities.
In the left-side navigation, click Overview.
The Findings Overview page appears.

overview-view-export.statement: The Findings Overview dashboard data is based on the selected view and filters; the view can be saved, and the dashboard data can be exported as a PDF file with the Export icon.

quotes: The dashboard data is based on the selected view and filters.
You can use the filters to customize the view, and also save the view for later.
You can click the Export icon at the top of the dashboard to export the data as a PDF file.

overview-top-tiles.statement: The Findings Overview top panel tiles give an overview of identity findings categorized by easy exploit and severity level; each tile shows the current number of findings in the account and clicking the number opens the Identity Findings page.

quotes: The tiles provide an overview of identity findings categorized by easy exploit and severity level.
Each tile shows the current number of findings in your account. Click the number to go to the Identity Findings page and analyze the issue.
Top Panel Tiles

overview-severity-widgets.statement: The Findings Overview page has widgets for identity findings by severity, by tenant by severity, and by identity provider (total findings per identity provider and the overall count).

quotes: View identity findings by severity.
View the distribution of identity findings across tenants by severity.
View the distribution of identity findings by identity provider, the total identity findings detected by each identity provider, and the overall findings count.

overview-ease-widgets.statement: The Findings Overview page has a Finding By Remediation Ease widget showing findings by remediation complexity (the page's example is prioritizing a finding that is high risk and easily remediated), and an Exploitability widget showing findings by exploitability and severity.

quotes: View the distribution of identity findings based on their complexity level to remediate. For example, you can prioritize a finding that is high risk and can be easily remediated.
View identity findings based on their exploitability and severity.
Finding By Remediation Ease
Exploitability

overview-asset-identity-widgets.statement: The Findings Overview page has widgets for findings by assets (total, critical and high findings per asset), assets by number of findings grouped by severity, findings by identities (total users and their findings), findings by user type and severity, and users by number of findings grouped by severity.

quotes: View the number of identity findings associated with assets. This allows you to quickly review findings for assets based on total findings, critical findings, and high findings.
View the assets list and the number of identity findings associated with them grouped by severity.
View the total users and the number of identity findings associated with them.
View the distribution of identity findings across different user types and severities.
View the number of identity findings associated with each user, grouped by severity.

overview-type-widgets.statement: The Findings Overview page has a widget of identity findings by finding type, exploit ease and severity with the total per type, and a corresponding widget limited to admins.

quotes: View identity findings by finding type, exploit ease, and severity, along with the total number of findings for each type.
View identity findings for admins by finding type, exploit ease, and severity.

remediation-purpose.statement: The Remediation dashboard (Identities > Remediation) provides insights into critical identity risks such as insecure account management and credential exposure, with metrics on severity distribution, exploitability, remediation ease, and findings across tenant, type and identities.

quotes: The Remediation dashboard in Identity Protection provides insights into critical identity risks such as insecure account management, credential exposure, etc.
You can view metrics related to severity distribution, exploitability, remediation ease, and findings across tenant, type, and identities.
On the Remediation dashboard (Identities > Remediation), you can do the following:

remediation-filters-export.statement: On the Remediation dashboard, filters can be applied and a view saved, and the data can be downloaded as a PDF with the Export icon.

quotes: Apply filters to view specific data and save a view.
Click the Export icon to download the data as a PDF.

remediation-statistics-tenant-type.statement: The Remediation dashboard's Statistics widget shows total critical findings that can be easily exploited and remediated plus newly detected critical findings; Critical Findings By Tenant is a bar chart of critical findings per tenant, and Critical Findings By Type groups risks by vulnerability type (for example insecure password and group management, weak authentication measures, insecure permissions).

quotes: View the total critical findings that can be easily exploited and remediated, and newly detected critical findings.
View the distribution of identity risks across tenants in a bar chart. Each bar represents tenants and the number of critical findings detected.
View the identity risks categorized by vulnerability type, such as insecure password and group management, weak authentication measures, insecure permissions, etc.
Statistics
Critical Findings By Tenant
Critical Findings By Type

remediation-ease-widget.statement: Critical Findings By Remediation Ease is a donut chart dividing critical findings into easy, moderate and difficult by the effort required to fix them, with a table of vulnerabilities (for example exposed passwords, legacy authentication, missing MFA) and their remediation ease.

quotes: The donut chart divides critical findings into easy, moderate, and difficult.
View the identity risks based on the effort required to fix them.
the table lists vulnerabilities, such as exposed passwords, legacy authentication, or missing MFA, along with their remediation ease.
Critical Findings By Remediation Ease

remediation-exploit-widget.statement: The exploit-ease widget (Critical Findings By Exploit Ease) is a donut chart dividing critical findings into exploitable levels such as easy, moderate and difficult, with a table of vulnerabilities and exploit ease ratings; the page says easily exploitable represents the highest risk because such findings require minimal attacker effort.

quotes: The donut chart divides critical findings into exploitable levels, such as easy, moderate, and difficult.
Easily exploitable represents the highest risk because these findings require minimal attacker effort
while the table lists specific vulnerabilities, such as excessive access groups, exposed passwords, or legacy authentication, along with their exploit ease rating.
Critical Findings By Exploit Ease

remediation-admin-user-widgets.statement: The Remediation dashboard has Critical Findings By Admin (proportion of admin accounts with active critical findings, with a table by vulnerability type), Findings By User Type (critical identity findings across internal users, external users and other identities, with the total at the center) and Admin Related Critical Findings By Exploit Ease (ease level of attack and number of active critical findings).

quotes: The donut chart shows the proportion of admin accounts with active critical findings, indicating risk spread.

View the distribution of critical identity findings across different categories of users. The donut chart provides a quick visual breakdown of internal users, external users, and other identities, with the total number of findings displayed at the center.
View vulnerabilities associated with administrative accounts, indicating ease level of attack and number of active critical findings.
Critical Findings By Admin
Findings By User Type
Admin Related Critical Findings By Exploit Ease
The table breaks down the type of vulnerabilities detected, such as weak authentication measures, insecure permissions, privilege management issues, etc.

dashboard-time-range.title: What time range, refresh interval, retention and default view the Findings Overview and Remediation dashboards use
dashboard-time-range.detail: The captured Findings Overview and Remediation pages describe widgets, filters, saved views and PDF export but state no time range, refresh interval, data retention or default view; the page screenshots are not captured, so widget layouts are unknown. They also name no role or permission needed to view or export the dashboards.

ease-criteria.title: What makes a critical finding easy, moderate or difficult to exploit or remediate
ease-criteria.detail: The Remediation page rates findings easy, moderate or difficult by effort required to fix, or by exploitability, but gives no criteria or thresholds for the levels; the same question for findings generally is open in identity-protection.identity-findings.
